chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me of it from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū ʿUbaydah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If a woman becomes pure during a prayer time and delays the salat (prayer) until the time of another salat (prayer) enters, then she sees blood, the qaḍāʾ of that salat (prayer) which she was negligent regarding is upon her.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the obligatory salat (prayer) due in that time
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.دَمًا: menstrual blood seen again after purity
key_terms.فَرَّطَتْ: she neglected or failed to perform in time
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: make-up performance of an obligation after its time

ai.seo_question: If a woman becomes pure during prayer time but delays the prayer and then menstruation returns, does she have to make up that prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who becomes pure from menstruation during the time of salat (prayer). If she delays that salat (prayer) until the next prayer time begins and then menstruation returns, she must perform the qaḍāʾ of the prayer she neglected.
